acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Lane creation through PR creation, merge, and closeout needs zero manual metadata repair
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Counter-evidenced by this lane. Automated closeout run 31876087851 failed (P3, C4, R1, R2) and required an audited manual recovery: merge SHA bound by hand, model-routing.json repaired, and R1/R2 recorded as a PM exception. The automatic path has not yet completed successfully for a merged lane, so this criterion is recorded FAILED and excepted rather than PASS. It may only be marked PASS once a lane completes creation, PR, merge and closeout with zero manual metadata repair.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Existing same-URL and pr_url_mismatch regressions remain green.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Each control is proven by mutation
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Executor, workflow invocation, head-ref identity, default-branch trust, atomic acquisition, Linear relation, retargeted-binding, blocked-lane invalidation, terminal-state preservation, status-independent finalize refusal, canonical-base, and reopen-generation mutations were killed and restored.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Privileged PR automation executes only protected default-branch code and validates PR base identity
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Workflow regression requires default-branch checkout, pull_request_target, ignored install scripts, explicit --base validation, edited-event revalidation, and bounded branch-update retries; event tests reject unbound mismatched bases and invalidate an exact existing binding after retargeting even when the lane is already blocked.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: A PR retargeted away from manifest.base_branch cannot record or finalize a wrong-base merge
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Production-path regressions prove both defenses: the edited event clears pr_url regardless of current lane status, preserves unrelated blockers and every terminal lifecycle outcome, and canonical-main lane-finalize independently queries GitHub and refuses a merged PR whose current base is release-candidate even when the manifest has no blocker. All load-bearing mutations are killed.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Finalize retries are serialized and preserve concurrent Linear labels
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: Focused tests prove atomic cross-issue acquisition, merge-mutex/journal exclusion, refused-acquisition cleanup, orphaned journal recovery, reopen-generation invalidation of completed steps, repeatable reconciliation, and relation-specific tier writes that retain a concurrently added non-tier label.

acceptance_criteria_mapping.criterion: Any named remedy is executed by a test
acceptance_criteria_mapping.evidence: The workflow event path, Linear label writer/verifier, positional parser, merge-truth inference, and partial-finalize resume journal are directly executed by regression coverage.

known_limitations: The PR-open workflow intentionally skips non-UTV2 branches and external-fork heads; it fails closed on malformed or conflicting lane manifests.
